summary_en: This phase 2 study tests isatuximab, dexamethasone and lenalidomide given with a slow, gentle approach in people with very frail, newly diagnosed multiple myeloma or plasma cell leukemia. Subcutaneous isatuximab is given weekly during the first two 28-day cycles and then every two weeks, with dexamethasone given on isatuximab days and lenalidomide added after two cycles. The record does not state a primary outcome measure; its stated goal is to learn whether this approach improves treatment adherence and quality of life.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa isatuximab, dexametasona y lenalidomida administrados con un enfoque lento y suave en personas con mieloma múltiple o leucemia de células plasmáticas de nuevo diagnóstico y muy frágiles. El isatuximab subcutáneo se administra semanalmente durante los primeros dos ciclos de 28 días y después cada dos semanas, la dexametasona se administra los días de isatuximab, y la lenalidomida se añade después de dos ciclos. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; su objetivo declarado es saber si este enfoque mejora la adherencia al tratamiento y la calidad de vida.
who_for: Newly diagnosed multiple myeloma and/or plasma cell leukemia, having completed one or fewer prior cycles of myeloma treatment.
IMWG frailty score of 3 or higher.
Recovered to baseline or grade 1 or less from toxicities of any prior treatment, unless clinically nonsignificant or stable.
Able to give informed consent and agree to the protocol contraception requirements.
not_for: Any condition that the investigator judges would compromise understanding, consent, or safe participation.
Known prior severe (grade 3 or higher) hypersensitivity to the study drug or its components.
Currently taking medications prohibited by the protocol.
